name: What preparation is needed before viewing duplex properties?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before viewing duplex properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before viewing duplex properties, it's beneficial to have your financing pre-approved, understand your budget, and define your investment goals (e.g., maximizing rental income, owner-occupancy). Research the areas you're interested in, such as Aventura or Pinecrest, to understand local rental rates and property values. Having a clear idea of your priorities for each unit, including potential renovations, will help streamline the viewing process and make it more productive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by securing financing, defining your budget and investment goals, and researching target areas.
